about: Each block's marccent-theme component (markup/settings.json) and every place WordPress differs, with why. Read by tools/settings.mjs (npm run test:settings).

later.active: false renders nothing: on WordPress that's the Show if tune (Marccent Content)

wordpress.minimumHeight: the block's height: the Animation fills its parent, and the block is that parent
wordpress.surface: a background behind the canvas, a class on the block

wordpress.label: its content (the content setting) kept in an attribute
wordpress.color: the .btn look, a class (the classes tune)
wordpress.hover: a hover class (hover-*); empty takes the site's

differs.icon: settings.json's default is false, which isn't a text: kept as arrow-right until the theme fixes it (Button.icon)

later.disabled: a disabled link isn't one; for buttons in forms, not offered yet

wordpress.code: its content (the content setting) kept in an attribute

wordpress.ratio: the block's aspect ratio, a style on its wrapper

wordpress.csv: the rows typed as CSV until they come from a field group (PRODUCT-LINE.md 6.1, admin data)

later.columns: read from the CSV's first line until the rows are admin data (6.1)
later.rows: admin data: a field group's rows (6.1)

wordpress.buttonLabel: the button that opens it: the theme's Drawer takes show and setShow, the block draws that Button
wordpress.dialogId: the id that links the button to the dialog

wordpress.formId: the form's id for its entries (forms admin data)
wordpress.successMessage: what the visitor reads once it's sent
wordpress.webhook: where entries are also sent (forms admin data)
wordpress.saveTo: the Fields type its entries are kept in (forms admin data)

wordpress.type: the input's type (text, email, a list, a file…); Field's as follows from it
wordpress.required: the input's own attribute, checked on the server too
wordpress.options: a list's choices, one per line
wordpress.showIf: shown only when another field's answer matches (the form's own steps)

later.as: chosen from type: select for a list, textarea for long text

differs.name: a form field needs a name to be sent: a new block starts with rating

later.defaultValue: a starting score: not offered in forms yet
later.disabled: a locked field: not offered in forms yet

differs.name: a form field needs a name to be sent: a new block starts with tags
differs.suggestions: typed as one line, comma-separated, and split on the server

later.defaultValue: starting tags: not offered in forms yet

later.at: placed row by row (perRow) until a placement editor is offered
later.gap: settings.json lists gap classes as its choices while the prop is a scale (0.94): the theme's fix first

html.why: WordPress's own: hand-written HTML, no theme component

wordpress.shape: the icon's box, a class (shape-*): Icon is the glyph only
wordpress.label: its aria-label (none: hidden from screen readers)

differs.name: a new block starts with a star, so it shows something to change

wordpress.lat: the place typed in: becomes center ({ lat, lng }) once places are a field group's rows (6.1)
wordpress.link: a link under the map to open it in Google Maps

differs.marker: a pin at the place, on or off; settings.json's marker is that pin's text

later.apiKey: the site's key, from Appearance → Marccent settings (admin data), not the block
later.markers: the places: a field group's rows (6.1)

wordpress.menu: which menu, by its slug, from Appearance → Menus (admin data)
wordpress.location: or the menu in a location (Primary: the header's main menu; admin data)

later.gap: not offered yet: the theme's default gap-sm
later.hover: not offered yet: dropdowns open on a click

wordpress.align: where the block sits in its row (justify-self)
wordpress.visitors: what Appearance → Marccent theme, Visitors allows instead (the header's: a Theme button, or single controls)

wordpress.buttonLabel: the button that opens it: the theme's Modal takes show and setShow, the block draws that Button
wordpress.dialogId: the id that links the button to the dialog

wordpress.kind: items on a ring, or the theme's OrbitClock or SolarSystem

later.positions: Without items: bare positions; the block draws items, or its clock and solar system

wordpress.image: an image instead of the icon (the theme's OrbitItem takes it as a node)

differs.value: settings.json gives the score no default (it's required); the block starts at 4.5 so a new one shows stars, not 0

differs.layers: typed as one line, comma-separated, and split in render.php

wordpress.imageId: the image's id in the media library

later.active: its own Start and Stop run it
later.controls: always on: the Stopwatch block is Counter with controls

wordpress.trigger: the text it's on: Tooltip's children
